rows.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 ci2 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for something that has just begun or is only starting to exist.

example.english: This nascent project is still rough, so give it some time.
example.traditional: 呢個啱啱開始嘅計劃仲好粗疏，大家畀啲時間佢啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 ci2 ge3 gai3 waak6 zung6 hou2 cou1 so1 daai6 gaa1 bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 keoi5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a newly developing field, industry, technology, or trend rather than for any individual thing that has just started.

example.english: The nascent electric-vehicle industry has attracted many investors.
example.traditional: 新興嘅電動車業吸引咗好多投資者。
example.jyutping: san1 hing1 ge3 din6 dung6 ce1 jip6 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 tau4 zi1 ze2
